---
title: "Mermaid Revealjs"
format: revealjs
# bd-5m4ga0s1: same transform output inside a reveal deck — the
# diagram <pre> sits inside a slide <section>, and the runtime script
# reaches the deck through the rendered.includes.after-body slot wired
# into the reveal scaffold (render_revealjs_document).
#
# bd-mermaid-runtime-not-bundled-vxejw159: decks bundle the runtime
# too. This is the case most at risk of silent regression — the reveal
# scaffold collects only `js:revealjs:*` artifacts, so keying the
# runtime as a template script would emit no tag here at all.
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ["section pre.mermaid"]
        - []
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            "<pre class=\"mermaid\">",
            "<script src=\"[^\"]*mermaid\\.min\\.js\"></script>",
            "mermaid\\.run\\(\\{ querySelector: 'pre\\.mermaid' \\}\\)",
          ]
        - ["cdn\\.jsdelivr\\.net"]
---
